# case: caa

## notes
fix.n.caa-tree {"name":"example.com"}
## check
z=example.com&r=is+@+CAA+0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org;+validationmethods=dns-01%22%7C0+issue+%22pki.goog;+validationmethods=dns-01%22%7C0+issuewild+%22;%22%7C0+iodef+%22mailto:security@example.com%22%5E0+issue+%22pki.goog%22
## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; example.com CAA
@ 3600 IN CAA 0 issue "letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01"
@ 3600 IN CAA 0 issue "pki.goog; validationmethods=dns-01"
@ 3600 IN CAA 0 issuewild ";"
@ 3600 IN CAA 0 iodef "mailto:security@example.com"
; delete: @ 3600 IN CAA 0 issue "pki.goog"
## route53
{
  "Comment": "DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "example.com.",
        "Type": "CAA",
        "TTL": 3600,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "0 issue \"letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01\""
          },
          {
            "Value": "0 issue \"pki.goog; validationmethods=dns-01\""
          },
          {
            "Value": "0 issuewild \";\""
          },
          {
            "Value": "0 iodef \"mailto:security@example.com\""
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Add example.com CAA 0 issue "letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CAA","name":"example.com","data":{"flags":0,"tag":"issue","value":"letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01"},"ttl":3600}'

# 2. Add example.com CAA 0 issue "pki.goog; validationmethods=dns-01"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CAA","name":"example.com","data":{"flags":0,"tag":"issue","value":"pki.goog; validationmethods=dns-01"},"ttl":3600}'

# 3. Add example.com CAA 0 issuewild ";"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CAA","name":"example.com","data":{"flags":0,"tag":"issuewild","value":";"},"ttl":3600}'

# 4. Add example.com CAA 0 iodef "mailto:security@example.com"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CAA","name":"example.com","data":{"flags":0,"tag":"iodef","value":"mailto:security@example.com"},"ttl":3600}'

# 5. Delete example.com CAA 0 issue "pki.goog"
#    Find each record's id, then:
curl -sS "$API?type=CAA&name=example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
## cloudflare notes
fix.fn.cloudflare-ids {}
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
'':
  - type: CAA
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - flags: 0
        tag: issue
        value: 'letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01'
      - flags: 0
        tag: issue
        value: 'pki.goog; validationmethods=dns-01'
      - flags: 0
        tag: issuewild
        value: ';'
      - flags: 0
        tag: iodef
        value: 'mailto:security@example.com'
## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

# delete: remove the resources of example.com CAA 0 issue "pki.goog"

resource "cloudflare_record" "caa_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "CAA"
  data {
    flags = 0
    tag   = "issue"
    value = "letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01"
  }
  ttl      = 3600
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "caa_apex_2" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "CAA"
  data {
    flags = 0
    tag   = "issue"
    value = "pki.goog; validationmethods=dns-01"
  }
  ttl      = 3600
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "caa_apex_3" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "CAA"
  data {
    flags = 0
    tag   = "issuewild"
    value = ";"
  }
  ttl      = 3600
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "caa_apex_4" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "CAA"
  data {
    flags = 0
    tag   = "iodef"
    value = "mailto:security@example.com"
  }
  ttl      = 3600
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "caa_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.com"
  type    = "CAA"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["0 issue \"letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01\"", "0 issue \"pki.goog; validationmethods=dns-01\"", "0 issuewild \";\"", "0 iodef \"mailto:security@example.com\""]
}
## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: CAA records
   Name: example.com
   Values:
     0 issue "letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01"
     0 issue "pki.goog; validationmethods=dns-01"
     0 issuewild ";"
     0 iodef "mailto:security@example.com"
   TTL: 3600
   This removes:
     0 issue "pki.goog"

Notes:
- CAA at example.com applies to every name below it that has no CAA record of its own.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+@+CAA+0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org;+validationmethods=dns-01%22%7C0+issue+%22pki.goog;+validationmethods=dns-01%22%7C0+issuewild+%22;%22%7C0+iodef+%22mailto:security@example.com%22%5E0+issue+%22pki.goog%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: CAA kayıtları
   Ad: example.com
   Değerler:
     0 issue "letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01"
     0 issue "pki.goog; validationmethods=dns-01"
     0 issuewild ";"
     0 iodef "mailto:security@example.com"
   TTL: 3600
   Bu değişiklikle kalkanlar:
     0 issue "pki.goog"

Notlar:
- example.com adındaki CAA, kendi CAA kaydı olmayan altındaki her ada da uygulanır.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+@+CAA+0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org;+validationmethods=dns-01%22%7C0+issue+%22pki.goog;+validationmethods=dns-01%22%7C0+issuewild+%22;%22%7C0+iodef+%22mailto:security@example.com%22%5E0+issue+%22pki.goog%22
